claims.claim: max_loras_per_batch counts distinct adapter IDs including None for base-model requests.
claims.notes: GPU pool capacity, not number of rows.

claims.claim: max_loaded_loras limits CPU-resident adapters and is separate from GPU batch slot capacity.
claims.notes: When set, max_loaded_loras must be at least max_loras_per_batch.

claims.claim: Pinned adapters remain in GPU slots and the maximum pinned count is max_loras_per_batch minus one.
claims.notes: The cap prevents pinned adapters from occupying every slot.

claims.claim: Dynamic load/unload endpoints are admin APIs requiring an admin API key and explicit shape compatibility planning.
claims.notes: Rank and target module shapes should be configured at startup.

claims.claim: The LoRA manager checks overlap-loading compatibility with the configured memory pool and parallel topology.
claims.locator: LoRAManager initialization and overlap loading checks
claims.notes: Not every pool supports DP-attention overlap loading.

claims.claim: KV prefixes computed under different adapter identities must not be reused as if they were equivalent.
claims.locator: LoRA adapter identity and memory pool integration
claims.notes: Adapter-dependent hidden states require cache namespace compatibility.
